hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push'; then cd /home/user/deploy-to-azure-cli-extension && PYTHONPATH=/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages:/tmp/new_setuptools pytest deploy-to-azure/azext_deploy_to_azure/tests/ -q 2>&1 || exit 1; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then cd /home/user/deploy-to-azure-cli-extension && PYTHONPATH=/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages:/tmp/new_setuptools python -m pylint --rcfile pylintrc ./deploy-to-azure/azext_deploy_to_azure 2>&1 | tail -3; fi
